questions.prompt: Do you go to sleep early or stay up late?
questions.sampleA1:
I go to sleep late.

I like TV.
questions.sampleA2:
I stay up late and watch movies.

I am tired in the morning, but I like the movies.

It's fun.
questions.sampleB1:
I usually stay up late because I like to watch videos online.

Sometimes I read a book too.

I know it's not very healthy, and I should probably sleep earlier.

But I enjoy the free time in the evening.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I'm very much a night owl. I tend to stay up late because the evening is really the only time I get to myself after work. I'll usually wind down with a series or a bit of reading. I know I ought to turn in earlier, but I just can't seem to break the habit.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men kechgacha uxlamayman va kinolar ko'raman.

Men ertalab charchagan bo'laman, lekin menga kinolar yoqadi.

Bu qiziqarli.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men odatda kech yotaman, chunki internetda videolar ko'rishni yoqtiraman.

Ba'zan kitob ham o'qiyman.

Bilaman, bu unchalik foydali emas va ehtimol erta uxlashim kerak.

Lekin menga kechqurungi bo'sh vaqt yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men odatda kech yotishga moyilman, aslida.

Menimcha, kechki payt ish bilan band bo'lgan kundan keyin o'zimga tegishli bo'lgan yagona vaqt.

Ko'pincha bu vaqtdan shaxsiy loyihalarni amalga oshirish yoki shunchaki yaxshi kitob yoki teleshou bilan dam olish uchun foydalanaman.

Yetarli uxlash sog'lig'im va unumdorligim uchun juda muhimligini bilsam ham, ba'zida o'sha qo'shimcha dam olish soatlarining vasvasasiga qarshi tura olmayman.

Bu biroz muvozanatni saqlash, aslida.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Do you go to sleep early or stay up late?...
idioms: hit the hay - "uxlashga yotmoq"
"The early bird catches the worm" - "Ertalabki qush qurtni tutadi"
burn the candle at both ends - "ikki tomondan shamni yoqmoq"
"Sleep like a log" - "qoziqdek qattiq uyquda bo'lmoq"
catch some Z's - "biroz uxlamoq"
phrases: burning the midnight oil - "tungi ish bilan band bo'lish"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find myself..." - "Rostini aytsam, men o'zimni..."
"From my perspective, the serenity of the night..." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, kechaning sokinligi..."
"I'd have to say that my nocturnal habits..." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, mening tungi odatlarim..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
To be perfectly honest, I tend to stay up late. The reason is that I'm incredibly drawn to the tranquility of the night. There's something about the stillness and silence that helps me unwind from the day's hustle and bustle. It's in these quiet hours that I find I can catch up on my reading or even dive into a bit of creative writing, which I find truly rewarding.

Of course, there are downsides to this habit. I've noticed that burning the midnight oil can take a toll on my energy levels the next day. However, I try to strike a balance by ensuring I get enough rest during the weekends. As the saying goes, "Early to bed and early to rise makes a person healthy, wealthy, and wise," yet for me, the night is when I feel most alive.

So, while I understand the importance of a routine, I genuinely enjoy the peace that comes with the night. It's a time when I can reflect on the day's events and plan for the future, allowing me to carve out moments for self-improvement and introspection.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, men kech yotishga moyilman. Buning sababi, men tunning sokinligiga juda ham qiziqaman. Tinchlik va sukunatda kunduzgi shovqin-surondan dam olishga yordam beradigan nimadir bor. Aynan shu sokin soatlarda men o'qishga ulguraman yoki hatto ijodiy yozuv bilan shug'ullanaman, bu menga chinakam zavq bag'ishlaydi.

Albatta, bu odatning kamchiliklari ham bor. Men tunni bedor o'tkazish ertasi kuni energiya darajamga ta'sir qilishini sezdim. Biroq, men dam olish kunlari yetarli dam olishga harakat qilib, muvozanatni saqlashga harakat qilaman. Maqol aytganidek, "Erta yotib, erta turgan odam sog'lom, boy va dono bo'ladi", lekin men uchun tun - bu men o'zimni eng tirik his qiladigan vaqt.

Shunday ekan, men kun tartibining muhimligini tushunsam ham, tunda keladigan tinchlikdan chin dildan zavqlanaman. Bu kunning voqealarini tahlil qilish va kelajakni rejalashtirish mumkin bo'lgan vaqt, bu menga o'z-o'zini takomillashtirish va ichki dunyoga nazar solish uchun vaqt ajratishga imkon beradi.

questions.prompt: How do you feel in the morning if you stay up late?
questions.sampleA2: I feel bad. I am very tired and I don't want to wake up. I want to sleep more, but I need to go to work.
questions.sampleB1: If I stay up late, I feel really tired in the morning. I don't have much energy, and it's hard to concentrate. I think it's important to get enough sleep, but sometimes I want to watch a movie or something. So, the next day is difficult.
questions.sampleB2: Honestly, I feel pretty rough. When I've had a late night, I wake up feeling groggy and it takes me ages to get going. I struggle to concentrate, and I end up running on coffee just to keep my eyes open. By the afternoon I've completely run out of steam, so I really do pay the price for those extra hours.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men o'zimni yomon his qilaman. Men juda charchaganman va uyg'onishni xohlamayman. Men ko'proq uxlashni xohlayman, lekin ishlashga borishim kerak.
questions.uzSampleB1: Agar men kechgacha uxlamay qolsam, ertalab o'zimni juda charchagan his qilaman. Menda unchalik ko'p energiya bo'lmaydi va diqqatimni jamlash qiyin bo'ladi. Menimcha, yetarlicha uxlash muhim, lekin ba'zida kino ko'rishni yoki shunga o'xshash narsalarni xohlayman. Shunday qilib, keyingi kun qiyin bo'ladi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Agar men kechgacha uxlamay qolsam, ertasi kuni albatta oqibatlarini sezaman. Odatda juda lanj bo'laman va motivatsiya topishga qiynalaman. Diqqatim past bo'ladi va ishda ko'proq xatolarga yo'l qo'yaman. Kechqurun qo'shimcha vaqtga ega bo'lish menga yoqsa-da, uyquning yetishmasligi keyingi kuni mening unumdorligimga va umumiy kayfiyatimga ta'sir qiladi, shuning uchun imkon qadar bundan qochishga harakat qilaman.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - How do you feel in the morning if you stay up late...
idioms: running on fumes - "so'nggi kuch bilan harakat qilish"
"Burning the midnight oil often leaves me feeling like a zombie in the morning." - "Tunda kech uxlamoq meni ertalab zombi kabi his qilishimga olib keladi."
not firing on all cylinders - "to'liq quvvatda ishlamaslik"
phrases: deprived of restful sleep - "dam olish uchun yetarli uyqudan mahrum bo'lish"

"From my perspective, staying up late results in a noticeable lack of energy and focus the following morning." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, kechikib uxlash ertalab sezilarli darajada energiya va diqqatning yetishmasligiga olib keladi."

"I'd have to say that the aftermath of a late night is usually a sluggish and groggy start to my day." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, kechasi uxlamaslikning oqibati odatda kunimning sekin va lohas boshlanishidir."

questions.sampleAnswer: When I stay up late, I honestly feel like a zombie the next morning. My mind is foggy, and I find it incredibly challenging to focus on anything. It's almost as if someone has pressed the pause button on my cognitive abilities. I tend to run on caffeine, which is a double-edged sword because while it gives me an initial boost, I come crashing down in the afternoon. "Early to bed and early to rise, makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise," is something I genuinely believe in, but it's a mantra that's easier said than done. On the rare occasions when I do burn the midnight oil, I pay the price with a day filled with mental sluggishness and low energy levels.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Agar men kechgacha uxlamay qolsam, rostini aytsam, ertalab o'zimni xuddi zombi kabi his qilaman. Fikrim chalkash bo'ladi va biror narsaga diqqatni jamlash juda qiyin bo'ladi. Go'yo kimdir mening kognitiv qobiliyatlarimni pauzaga qo'yib qo'ygandek bo'ladi. Men kofein bilan "ishlashga" harakat qilaman, bu esa ikki tomonlama qilichdir, chunki u menga dastlabki kuch bersa-da, tushdan keyin "qulayman". "Erta yotib, erta turgan odam sog'lom, boy va dono bo'ladi" degan gapga men chin dildan ishonaman, lekin bu shiorni amalga oshirish oson emas. Kamdan-kam hollarda kechgacha ishlasam, buning "narxini" aqliy sustlik va energiya darajasining pastligi bilan to'layman.

questions.prompt: Does your name have any special meaning?
questions.sampleA1: My name... I am... My name is... good. I like it.
questions.sampleA2: My name is Maria. I think my name is common. But my mother says it is a nice name and it means star. I like stars.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think my name has a meaning. It's David, and it's a pretty common name, I guess. But I think it means 'beloved' or something like that. My parents chose it because they liked the sound of it, and also because it's a traditional family name. I don't know if it's really special, but I like it.
questions.sampleB2: Yes, actually, it does. I suppose my name is fairly traditional, but my parents chose it because it's been passed down through the family for generations. From what I've been told, it means something like 'gift', which I think is rather lovely. To be honest, I've grown quite fond of it over the years, even though I didn't always appreciate it as a child.
questions.uzSampleA1: Mening ismim... Men... Mening ismim... yaxshi. Menga yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Mening ismim Mariya. Menimcha, ismim keng tarqalgan. Lekin onam aytishicha, bu chiroyli ism va u yulduz degani. Menga yulduzlar yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Xo'sh, menimcha, ismimning ma'nosi bor. Mening ismim David, va bu juda keng tarqalgan ism, deb o'ylayman. Lekin menimcha, u "sevikli" yoki shunga o'xshash ma'noni anglatadi. Ota-onamga uning ovozi yoqqani uchun va shuningdek, bu an'anaviy oilaviy ism bo'lgani uchun tanlashgan. U haqiqatan ham maxsusmi yoki yo'qmi, bilmayman, lekin menga yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Ha, aslida, ismimning ma'nosi bor. Mening ismim Eleanor va menimcha, u yunon tilidan kelib chiqqan. U "yorqin, porloq nur" degan ma'noni anglatadi. Ota-onam uni ijobiy ma'noga ega va tarixiy tuyg'uga ega bo'lgan ism bo'lishini xohlashgan. Men har kuni bu ma'no haqida ongli ravishda o'ylamasam ham, uning zamiridagi hissiyotni qadrlayman. Ismingiz ijobiy va nurafshon narsa bilan bog'liqligini bilish yoqimli, hatto bu faqatgina nozik ta'sir bo'lsa ham.

questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, my name actually does have a special meaning. It's derived from ancient languages and it signifies a strong leader. Growing up, I was often told stories about how my ancestors carried this name with great pride and responsibility. I've grown into appreciating its significance more as I've matured. To be honest, there's a certain weight to having a name with such a powerful meaning, and it has spurred me on to strive for personal excellence. As the saying goes, "a good name is rather to be chosen than great riches", and I truly believe in living up to that ideal.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Ha, ismimning aslida maxsus ma'nosi bor. U qadimgi tillardan kelib chiqqan va kuchli yetakchini anglatadi. Katta bo'lganimda, menga ko'pincha ajdodlarim bu ismni katta faxr va mas'uliyat bilan olib yurganliklari haqida hikoyalar aytib berishardi. Men ulg'ayganim sari uning ahamiyatini yanada qadrlay boshladim. Rostini aytsam, shunday kuchli ma'noga ega ismga ega bo'lishning o'ziga xos og'irligi bor va bu meni shaxsiy mukammallikka intilishga undadi. Maqol aytganidek, "yaxshi nom katta boylikdan afzalroq", va men chin dildan shu idealga mos yashashga ishonaman.

questions.prompt: What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA1: I see kids. They play. One is inside. One is outside.
questions.sampleA2: I see children. In one picture, they are inside and playing with toys. And in the other picture, they are outside and playing a game. They look happy.
questions.sampleB1: In the first picture, I can see some kids playing inside. They are at a table with toys, I think. In the second picture, the kids are playing outside. They are throwing a ball. It looks like they are having fun. I think both pictures show children playing.
questions.sampleB2: So, in the first picture, I can see three young children sitting at a table indoors, playing with colourful modelling clay. It looks like a cosy playroom, with a big window and some other kids in the background. In the second picture, four children are outside on the grass, playing an energetic ball game in what looks like a park. The main difference, I'd say, is that the first is a calm, creative indoor activity, whereas the second is much more active and physical. Both, though, show kids having fun together.

Ular to'p otishyapti. Ularga juda ham qiziqarli bo'layotganga o'xshaydi. Menimcha, ikkala rasm ham bolalarning o'ynayotganini ko'rsatadi.

Ular sinf xonasida yoki bolalar bog'chasida bo'lishsa kerak. Ikkinchi rasmda bolalar tashqarida o'yin o'ynashyapti, balki to'p otishyapti. Ular jismoniy faollikdan zavqlanayotganga o'xshaydi. Ikkala rasmda ham bolalar turli xil o'yinlar bilan mashg'ul, biri ko'proq ijodiy, ikkinchisi esa ko'proq faol.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Well, in the first picture, I can see a group of young children sitting around a table indoors, playing with colourful toys, most likely modelling clay or playdough. They appear to be in a classroom or a nursery environment, as the furniture is child-sized and the setting looks safe and organised. The children seem focused and cooperative, which suggests they're developing creativity as well as social skills through play-based learning.

Anyway, in the second picture, several children are playing an energetic outdoor game on a grassy field, possibly in a park or school playground. They're gathered around a small circular net and throwing a ball to one another, which indicates a team-based activity. The children look enthusiastic and physically engaged, enjoying the freedom of outdoor play and interaction with their peers.

So, overall, both pictures depict children learning and socialising, but in different ways. The first image emphasises calm, creative indoor activity that supports cognitive development, while the second highlights physical exercise, teamwork, and outdoor fun. "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy," right? Together, they show a balanced approach to childhood development through both structured indoor play and active outdoor games. Personally, I think it's great to see kids having such a well-rounded experience.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Xo'sh, birinchi rasmda men bir guruh yosh bolalarni xonada stol atrofida o'tirib, rang-barang o'yinchoqlar bilan o'ynayotganini ko'ryapman, ehtimol, loy yoki plastilin bilan. Ular sinf xonasida yoki bolalar bog'chasida bo'lishsa kerak, chunki mebellar bolalar uchun mos o'lchamda va muhit xavfsiz va tartibli ko'rinadi. Bolalar diqqatini jamlagan va hamkorlikda ishlayotganga o'xshaydi, bu ularning o'yin orqali ijodkorlikni, shuningdek, ijtimoiy ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirayotganini ko'rsatadi.

Xullas, ikkinchi rasmda bir nechta bolalar o'tloqli maydonda, ehtimol parkda yoki maktab o'yingohida, serharakat ochiq havoda o'yin o'ynashmoqda. Ular kichik dumaloq to'r atrofida to'planishgan va bir-birlariga to'p uloqtirishmoqda, bu jamoaviy faoliyatni anglatadi. Bolalar ishtiyoq bilan va jismoniy faollik bilan mashg'ul bo'lib, ochiq havoda o'ynash va tengdoshlari bilan muloqot qilish erkinligidan zavqlanishmoqda.

Shunday qilib, umuman olganda, ikkala rasm ham bolalarning o'rganishi va muloqot qilishini tasvirlaydi, lekin turli yo'llar bilan. Birinchi rasm xotirjam, ijodiy xonadagi faoliyatga urg'u beradi, bu kognitiv rivojlanishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, ikkinchisi esa jismoniy mashqlar, jamoaviy ish va ochiq havoda o'yin-kulgi bilan ajralib turadi. "Faqat ish va o'yin bo'lmasa, odam zerikarli bo'lib qoladi," shundaymi? Birgalikda ular tuzilgan xonadagi o'yin va faol ochiq havoda o'yinlar orqali bolalik rivojlanishiga muvozanatli yondashuvni ko'rsatadi. Shaxsan men bolalarning bunday har tomonlama tajribaga ega bo'lishini ko'rish juda yaxshi deb o'ylayman.

questions.prompt: What are the advantages of indoor activities?
questions.sampleA1: I like inside. It is good. I play games. I watch TV.
questions.sampleA2: I like indoor activities. I like to read a book and watch movies. It's good when the weather is bad outside. I can stay warm and dry. But I also like to go outside sometimes.
questions.sampleB1: I think indoor activities are good. For example, you can read a book or watch a film. It's useful when the weather isn't good outside, like when it's raining. You can also do things like play board games with your family. However, it's also important to get exercise outside.
questions.sampleB2: Well, the main advantage, I suppose, is that you're not at the mercy of the weather. Whatever it's doing outside, you can still get on with things like reading or playing board games. On top of that, indoor activities are great for bringing people together and give you a chance to unwind. So all in all, they're a convenient option.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga ichkarida bo'lish yoqadi. Bu yaxshi. Men o'yinlar o'ynayman. Men televizor ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men yopiq joylardagi mashg'ulotlarni yaxshi ko'raman. Kitob o'qishni va kino ko'rishni yaxshi ko'raman. Tashqarida ob-havo yomon bo'lganda bu yaxshi. Men issiq va quruq holda qolishim mumkin. Lekin men ba'zan tashqariga ham chiqishni yaxshi ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, yopiq joylardagi mashg'ulotlar yaxshi.
Masalan, siz kitob o'qishingiz yoki film tomosha qilishingiz mumkin. Ob-havo tashqarida yaxshi bo'lmaganda, masalan, yomg'ir yog'ayotganda bu foydali. Siz oilangiz bilan stol o'yinlarini o'ynashingiz ham mumkin.
Biroq, tashqarida mashq qilish ham muhim.
questions.uzSampleB2: Yopiq xonalardagi mashg'ulotlarning ba'zi afzalliklari, albatta, bor. Asosiy foydalaridan biri shundaki, ular xavfsiz va qulay muhitni ta'minlaydi, ayniqsa, ob-havo yoqimsiz bo'lganda. Siz yomg'ir yoki haddan tashqari issiqlik haqida tashvishlanmasdan, o'qish yoki rasm chizish kabi sevimli mashg'ulotlaringiz bilan shug'ullanishingiz mumkin. Bundan tashqari, yopiq xonalardagi mashg'ulotlar do'stlar va oila a'zolari bilan muloqot qilishning yaxshi usuli bo'lishi mumkin, masalan, stol o'yinlarini o'ynash yoki birgalikda filmlar tomosha qilish orqali. Ochiq havoda vaqt o'tkazish muhim bo'lsa-da, yopiq xonalardagi mashg'ulotlar qimmatli alternativani taklif etadi, ayniqsa, yilning ma'lum vaqtlarida.

sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find indoor activities to be a haven of comfort and creativity." - "Rostini aytsam, men yopiq joydagi faoliyatlarni qulaylik va ijodkorlik manbai deb bilaman."

"From my perspective, engaging in indoor pursuits offers unparalleled opportunities for personal growth." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, yopiq joydagi mashg'ulotlar shaxsiy o'sish uchun mislsiz imkoniyatlar taqdim etadi."

"I'd have to say that indoor activities provide a unique blend of relaxation and stimulation." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, yopiq joydagi faoliyatlar dam olish va stimulyatsiyani o'ziga xos ravishda birlashtiradi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are a myriad of advantages associated with indoor activities, and I strongly believe they play a crucial role in our lives. Firstly, they offer a controlled environment, which is particularly beneficial during extreme weather conditions. When it's raining cats and dogs outside or scorching hot, being indoors allows individuals to engage in activities without any interruptions, ensuring comfort and safety.

Moreover, indoor activities often foster a creative atmosphere. Whether it's painting, playing musical instruments, or indulging in board games, such activities can bring out one's creativity and hone in on particular skills. Take my personal experience as an example—I picked up guitar playing during a rainy season and found it to be incredibly rewarding. It not only enhanced my musical abilities but also provided a therapeutic escape from daily stresses.

Another key advantage is the potential for social interaction. Indoor activities like team-based games or workshops provide opportunities to bond with others, fostering a sense of community. As the saying goes, "a friend in need is a friend indeed," and I have witnessed friendships blossom in such settings, where people come together for a common interest.

In essence, indoor activities offer a perfect mix of safety, creativity, and social engagement. They kill two birds with one stone by enhancing personal skills while promoting social bonds, thus making them an invaluable part of our lifestyle.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Yopiq xonalardagi mashg'ulotlarning afzalliklari juda ko'p va men ularning hayotimizda muhim rol o'ynashiga qat'iy ishonaman. Birinchidan, ular nazorat qilinadigan muhitni ta'minlaydi, bu ayniqsa ekstremal ob-havo sharoitida foydalidir. Tashqarida kuchli yomg'ir yog'ayotgan yoki jazirama issiq bo'lganda, yopiq xonalarda bo'lish odamlarga hech qanday to'siqlarsiz mashg'ulotlar bilan shug'ullanish, qulaylik va xavfsizlikni ta'minlash imkonini beradi.

Bundan tashqari, yopiq xonalardagi mashg'ulotlar ko'pincha ijodiy muhitni yaratadi. Bu rasm chizish, musiqa asboblarini chalish yoki stol o'yinlari bilan shug'ullanish bo'ladimi, bunday mashg'ulotlar odamning ijodkorligini ochib berishi va muayyan ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirishi mumkin. Shaxsiy tajribamni misol qilib olaylik - men yomg'irli mavsumda gitara chalishni o'rgandim va bu juda foydali ekanligini angladim. Bu nafaqat mening musiqiy qobiliyatimni oshirdi, balki kundalik stresslardan terapevtik qochish imkoniyatini ham berdi.

Yana bir asosiy afzallik - ijtimoiy aloqa uchun imkoniyat. Jamoaviy o'yinlar yoki seminarlar kabi yopiq xonalardagi mashg'ulotlar boshqalar bilan aloqa o'rnatish, hamjamiyat tuyg'usini rivojlantirish imkoniyatini beradi. "Do'st og'ir kunda bilinadi", deganlaridek, men odamlarning umumiy qiziqish uchun birga yig'iladigan bunday joylarda do'stliklarning gullab-yashnashiga guvoh bo'ldim.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, yopiq xonalardagi mashg'ulotlar xavfsizlik, ijodkorlik va ijtimoiy ishtirokning mukammal aralashmasini taklif etadi. Ular shaxsiy ko'nikmalarni oshirish bilan birga ijtimoiy aloqalarni mustahkamlab, bir o'q bilan ikki quyonni uradi va shu bilan ularni turmush tarzimizning bebaho qismiga aylantiradi.

questions.sampleAnswer: "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy." This "quote" perfectly illustrates why children are often drawn to outdoor activities. Honestly, these activities provide a natural playground that stimulates their senses and encourages exploration. From a psychological perspective, being outdoors brings about a sense of freedom and adventure, something that indoor environments might lack. Moreover, children tend to gravitate towards activities that allow them to expend energy and engage their physical prowess. Whether it's climbing trees, riding a bicycle, or playing a game of tag, these activities cater to their intrinsic need for play and movement. This is crucial in their developmental years, as it helps them develop motor skills and coordination. Furthermore, outdoor activities often provide a social experience that is invaluable for children. When they hang out with peers in a park or on a playground, they learn essential social skills like sharing, cooperation, and empathy. This not only enhances their interpersonal abilities but also fosters a sense of belonging and camaraderie. From my personal experience, having grown up in a suburban area, I revelled in the freedom of playing outside. Afternoon games with friends not only kept us on our toes but also created memories that I fondly cherish. Therefore, it's incredibly understandable why children are naturally inclined to enjoy outdoor activities. They offer an unparalleled mix of physical, mental, and social benefits that are essential for a child's overall development.

"Faqat ish bilan mashg'ul bo'lish bolani zerikarli qilib qo'yadi." Bu "ibora" bolalarning nima uchun ko'pincha ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlarga qiziqishini mukammal tarzda tasvirlaydi. Rostini aytsam, bu mashg'ulotlar ularning sezgilarini rag'batlantiradigan va tadqiqotga undaydigan tabiiy o'yin maydonini ta'minlaydi. Psixologik nuqtai nazardan, ochiq havoda bo'lish erkinlik va sarguzasht hissini uyg'otadi, bu narsa yopiq muhitda yetishmasligi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, bolalar o'z energiyasini sarflash va jismoniy qobiliyatlarini ishga solish imkonini beradigan mashg'ulotlarga intilishadi. Daraxtlarga chiqish, velosiped haydash yoki do'q o'yinini o'ynash kabi mashg'ulotlar ularning o'yin va harakatga bo'lgan ichki ehtiyojlarini qondiradi. Bu ularning rivojlanish yillarida juda muhim, chunki u motorika va muvofiqlashtirish qobiliyatlarini rivojlantirishga yordam beradi.

Bundan tashqari, ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlar ko'pincha bolalar uchun bebaho bo'lgan ijtimoiy tajribani taqdim etadi. Ular parkda yoki o'yin maydonchasida tengdoshlari bilan vaqt o'tkazganda, ular baham ko'rish, hamkorlik qilish va hamdardlik kabi muhim ijtimoiy ko'nikmalarni o'rganadilar. Bu nafaqat ularning shaxslararo qobiliyatlarini oshiradi, balki mansublik va o'rtoqlik tuyg'usini ham rivojlantiradi.

Shaxsiy tajribamdan kelib chiqadigan bo'lsam, shahar atrofi hududida o'sganim sababli, men tashqarida o'ynash erkinligidan zavqlanardim. Do'stlar bilan tushdan keyingi o'yinlar nafaqat bizni sergak qilib turardi, balki men qadrlaydigan xotiralarni ham yaratdi. Shuning uchun bolalarning ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlardan zavqlanishga moyil bo'lishi juda tushunarli. Ular bolaning umumiy rivojlanishi uchun zarur bo'lgan jismoniy, aqliy va ijtimoiy foydalarning beqiyos aralashmasini taklif etadi.

I was probably about nineteen at the time, and I'll be honest, I was pretty confident going in - maybe a bit too confident, looking back. The thing is, I'd had a fair few lessons and I thought I had it in the bag. But on the day, my nerves got the better of me. I made a silly mistake at a roundabout, pulled out when I shouldn't have, and the examiner failed me on the spot. To make matters worse, I stalled the car twice on the way back to the test centre. I was absolutely gutted, and for a while I felt like giving up altogether. But looking back, I actually learned a huge amount from the whole thing. First of all, it taught me that there's no substitute for proper preparation - I'd cut corners and it showed. More importantly, it taught me how to bounce back from disappointment rather than dwelling on it. I took a few more lessons, calmed my nerves, and passed second time round with flying colours. So, at the end of the day, failing that first test was probably a blessing in disguise. It knocked my confidence for a bit, but it made me far more careful and resilient. Honestly, I think we sometimes learn far more from our failures than we ever do from our successes. It's a lesson that's really stuck with me ever since.

bulletPoints: Describe a time when you tried to do something but you failed.
When it was and what you tried to do?
What did you learn from this failure?
questions.sampleAnswer: Honestly, one of the most eye-opening experiences of my life was when I attempted to launch my own online business about three years ago. It was during the summer, and I was determined to make a splash in the e-commerce world by selling handmade jewelry. At the time, I was brimming with enthusiasm, thinking big and setting up my website. Initially, everything seemed to be going according to plan. However, I soon realized that I had "bitten off more than I could chew". The complexities of digital marketing, inventory management, and customer service were overwhelming. I tried to figure out ways to enhance my marketing strategy, but my efforts were in vain. Ultimately, I had to admit defeat and close the business after several months. Despite the failure, this experience taught me invaluable lessons. I learned the importance of thorough market research and the necessity of a well-rounded business plan. Moreover, I discovered my resilience and capacity for rolling with the punches. Reflecting on this experience, I realized that every failure is a stepping stone to success. It reinforced the adage, "Failure is the stepping stone to success". Now, I view challenges as opportunities to grow, and I am all the wiser for it.

Bu yozda sodir bo'lgan edi va men qo'lda yasalgan zargarlik buyumlarini sotish orqali elektron tijorat olamida shov-shuv ko'tarishga qat'iy qaror qilgan edim. O'sha paytda men g'ayratga to'lib-toshgan edim, katta orzular qilib va o'z veb-saytimni sozlash bilan band edim.

Dastlab, hamma narsa reja bo'yicha ketayotgandek tuyuldi. Biroq, tez orada men "og'zimdan kattaroq luqma olganimni" angladim. Raqamli marketing, inventarizatsiyani boshqarish va mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishning murakkabliklari meni bosim ostida qoldirdi. Men marketing strategiyamni yaxshilash yo'llarini topishga harakat qildim, ammo urinishlarim behuda ketdi.

Oxir-oqibat, men mag'lubiyatni tan olishim va bir necha oydan keyin biznesni yopishimga to'g'ri keldi. Muvaffaqiyatsizlikka qaramay, bu tajriba menga bebaho saboqlar berdi. Men chuqur bozor tadqiqotining muhimligini va yaxlit biznes-rejaning zarurligini angladim. Bundan tashqari, men o'zimning chidamliligimni va zarbalarga bardosh berish qobiliyatimni kashf qildim.

Bu tajribani eslar ekanman, har bir muvaffaqiyatsizlik muvaffaqiyatga olib boradigan qadam ekanligini angladim. questions.prompt: Gardening should be taught at school.
questions.sampleA1: Garden good. I like garden. School garden good.
questions.sampleA2: I think garden is good. It's outside. We can grow plants and flowers. And we can learn about nature, but maybe it's boring for some kids.
questions.sampleB1: I think gardening in school is a good idea. It's healthy to be outside and do something active. For example, you can learn how to grow vegetables and that's useful. However, it might be difficult for some schools to find the space for a garden.
questions.sampleB2: Right, so the statement is that gardening should be taught at school, and to be honest, I can see the argument on both sides. On the one hand, there's a strong case for it. For a start, gardening gets kids away from their screens and out into the fresh air, which is bound to be good for their health. It also teaches them where their food actually comes from - a lot of children these days genuinely have no idea. On top of that, tending a garden instils a real sense of responsibility and patience, because you can't rush nature. And it ties in nicely with subjects like biology and science, so it's not as if it's a waste of time. On the other hand, I can understand why some people would push back. School timetables are already crammed, and teachers are under a lot of pressure to cover the core subjects. Squeezing in gardening might mean something more important gets pushed out. There's also the practical side - not every school has the space or the budget for it, especially in big cities. But if you ask me, the benefits far outweigh the drawbacks. I don't think it needs to be a full-blown subject with exams; it could just be the odd lesson here and there, or an after-school club. At the end of the day, giving children hands-on experience and a bit of a connection with nature can only be a good thing. So on balance, I'm all for it.

vocabulary.title: Q8 - Gardening should be taught at school....
idioms: Teaching gardening can transform students into green thumbs, fostering a deep love for horticulture. - "Bog'dorchilikni o'rgatish o'quvchilarni bog'dorchilikni chuqur sevishni rivojlantiruvchi mohir bog'bonlar qilish mumkin."

"Gardening in schools can turn students into nature enthusiasts, who find joy and fulfillment in nurturing plants." - "Maktablarda bog'dorchilik o'quvchilarni o'simliklarni parvarish qilishdan zavq va qoniqish topuvchi tabiat ishqibozlariga aylantirishi mumkin."
A school with a garden is like a seedbed of knowledge, where curiosity and learning flourish. - "Bog'li maktab bilim urug'ini ekish joyiga o'xshaydi, bu yerda qiziqish va o'rganish gullab-yashnaydi."
phrases: extensive collection of plant species in school gardens can provide a diverse learning environment for students. - "Maktab bog'laridagi o'simlik turlarining keng kolleksiyasi o'quvchilar uchun turli xil o'rganish muhitini ta'minlashi mumkin."

Encouraging students to become avid gardeners can instill a lifelong appreciation for nature and sustainability. - "O'quvchilarni qizg'in bog'bonlarga aylantirish tabiat va barqarorlikni bir umr qadrlashni singdirishi mumkin."

School gardens can be considered as educational treasures where students can learn about biology, ecology, and nutrition. - "Maktab bog'larini o'quvchilar biologiya, ekologiya va ovqatlanish haqida o'rganishi mumkin bo'lgan o'quv xazinasi deb hisoblash mumkin."
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I believe that introducing gardening into the school curriculum would be immensely beneficial for students' holistic development." - "Rostini aytsam, men bog'dorchilikni maktab dasturiga kiritish o'quvchilarning har tomonlama rivojlanishi uchun nihoyatda foydali bo'lishiga ishonaman."

"From my perspective, incorporating gardening lessons in schools could cultivate a sense of responsibility and environmental awareness among students." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, maktablarda bog'dorchilik darslarini kiritish o'quvchilar orasida mas'uliyat va atrof-muhitga nisbatan ongni rivojlantirishi mumkin."

"I'd have to say that teaching gardening at school could serve as an excellent hands-on learning experience, enriching students' understanding of nature." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, maktabda bog'dorchilikni o'rgatish tabiatni tushunishni boyituvchi ajoyib amaliy o'rganish tajribasi bo'lishi mumkin."

for: Spending time in a garden can be incredibly relaxing for pupils.
Students can learn about planting and growing food.
Gardening fosters an appreciation for the natural world.
against: Schools already have packed schedules, and adding another subject can be challenging.
Not all schools have suitable outdoor space for a garden.
While some students might find gardening engaging, others may not be interested in it.

questions.sampleAnswer:
In my opinion, the notion of incorporating gardening into the school curriculum is truly commendable. On the one hand, spending time in a garden can be incredibly relaxing for pupils. Not only does it offer a respite from the hustle and bustle of the classroom, but it also provides students with a unique opportunity to immerse themselves in a tranquil environment. This can help reduce stress and anxiety, which are increasingly prevalent among young people today.

Moreover, gardening can teach students essential life skills, such as planting and growing food. These skills are invaluable as they foster self-sufficiency and an appreciation for the food they consume. Additionally, gardening promotes an appreciation for the natural world. By understanding the intricate processes involved in nature, students can develop a deeper connection with the environment, which might inspire them to become more environmentally conscious citizens.

On the flip side, I understand that schools already have packed schedules, and incorporating another subject like gardening can be challenging. The academic calendar is often jam-packed with core subjects that are deemed essential for a student's educational development. Furthermore, not all schools have suitable outdoor space for a garden. In urban areas, for instance, schools might struggle to allocate adequate space for such activities, making it logistically difficult to implement.

Additionally, while some students might find gardening engaging, others may not be interested in it. It's essential to consider the diverse interests of students, as forcing them into an activity they couldn't care less about might lead to disengagement. "One man's meat is another man's poison," and this "rings true" in educational settings where interests can vary widely.

In conclusion, while there are several benefits to teaching gardening in schools, such as relaxation, skill development, and environmental appreciation, there are also significant challenges, like logistical constraints and varying student interests. Balancing these considerations is crucial for any educational reform.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Mening fikrimcha, bog'dorchilikni maktab o'quv dasturiga kiritish g'oyasi haqiqatan ham maqtovga loyiq. Bir tomondan, bog'da vaqt o'tkazish o'quvchilar uchun juda tinchlantiruvchi bo'lishi mumkin. Bu nafaqat sinf xonasining shovqinidan dam olish imkoniyatini beradi, balki talabalarga sokin muhitga sho'ng'ish uchun noyob imkoniyatni ham taqdim etadi. Bu bugungi kunda yoshlar orasida tobora keng tarqalgan stress va xavotirni kamaytirishga yordam berishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, bog'dorchilik talabalarga oziq-ovqat ekish va yetishtirish kabi muhim hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatishi mumkin. Bu ko'nikmalar o'zini-o'zi ta'minlashni rag'batlantirgani va iste'mol qiladigan oziq-ovqatga nisbatan minnatdorchilikni oshirgani uchun juda qimmatlidir. Qo'shimcha ravishda, bog'dorchilik tabiatga nisbatan hurmatni oshiradi. Tabiatda sodir bo'ladigan murakkab jarayonlarni tushunish orqali talabalar atrof-muhit bilan chuqurroq aloqani rivojlantirishi mumkin, bu ularni atrof-muhitga e'tiborliroq fuqarolarga aylanishga ilhomlantirishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, men maktablarning jadvali allaqachon to'la ekanligini va bog'dorchilik kabi yana bir fanni kiritish qiyin bo'lishi mumkinligini tushunaman. O'quv yili ko'pincha talabaning ta'lim rivojlanishi uchun zarur deb hisoblangan asosiy fanlar bilan to'lib-toshgan. Bundan tashqari, hamma maktablarda ham bog' uchun mos tashqi maydon mavjud emas. Masalan, shahar joylarida maktablar bunday tadbirlar uchun yetarli joy ajratishga qiynalishi mumkin, bu esa uni logistik jihatdan amalga oshirishni qiyinlashtiradi.

Bundan tashqari, ba'zi talabalar bog'dorchilikni qiziqarli deb topsa, boshqalari unga qiziqmasligi mumkin. Talabalarning turli xil qiziqishlarini hisobga olish muhim, chunki ularni qiziqtirmaydigan faoliyatga majburlash ularning ishtiyoqini so'ndirishi mumkin. "Bir kishining oshi, boshqa kishining zaharidir" deganlaridek, bu qiziqishlar juda xilma-xil bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan ta'lim muhitida ham o'z tasdig'ini topadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, maktablarda bog'dorchilikni o'qitishning bir qancha afzalliklari mavjud, masalan, dam olish, ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirish va atrof-muhitga nisbatan minnatdorchilik, shuningdek, logistik cheklovlar va talabalarning turli xil qiziqishlari kabi jiddiy muammolar ham mavjud. Har qanday ta'lim islohotlari uchun bu fikrlarni muvozanatlash juda muhimdir.
